name: FA_TRX_EXTRACT
description: FA_TRX_EXTRACT contains a denormalized and flattened representation of fixed assets and their transactions.  The contents are available for simplied reporting, in particular for OTBI real time subject areas.

columns.name: TRX_EXTRACT_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated identifier for the row in the transaction extract.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation period.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the period for which data is extracted.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE
columns.description: Indicates the table from which each row was extracted.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the whether the row was extracted for a transaction or periodic depreciation row.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger unique identifier.

columns.name: LEDGER_SET_ID
columns.description: Ledget set identifer. Foreign key to GL_LEDGERS.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the currency of the extracted line.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: ASSET_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the asset allowed in the Oracle Fusion Assets. The asset types allowed are Capitalized, CIP (Construction-in-Process), Expensed, and Group.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Asset category identifier.

columns.name: CATEGORY_BOOK_DEFAULT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the default depreciation rules for the category in the book.

columns.name: UNITS_ASSIGNED
columns.description: Number of units assigned to the distribution.

columns.name: TOTAL_UNITS
columns.description: Total number of units assigned to the asset.

columns.name: UNIT_RATIO
columns.description: Ratio of the units to total units.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset distribution.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Depreciation expense account identifier.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location flexfield identification number.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the employee to whom the asset is assigned.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifier of the asset transaction type performed.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_KEY
columns.description: General class of transaction. Possible values are R for retirements, UA for unplanned depreciation amortized from current period, and UE for unplanned depreciation expensed.

columns.name: CAPITALIZATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this transaction was the result of a capitalization.

columns.name: INVOICE_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the invoice transaction.

columns.name: INVOICE_TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Identifier of the invoice transaction type performed.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset accounting line.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset source line.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Asset transaction type of the accounting line.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
columns.description: The type of account this row affects.

columns.name: TRACK_MEMBER_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the account information is created at the member asset level or at group asset level.

columns.name: SOURCE_DEST_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether this line is on the source or destination side of a transaction.

columns.name: BOOKS_TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the associated row in FA_BOOKS for this extracted line.

columns.name: OLD_BOOKS_TRX_ID_IN
columns.description: Identifier of the associated row in FA_BOOKS which was terminated by this transaction.

columns.name: NEW_BOOKS_TRX_ID_IN
columns.description: Identifier of the associated row in FA_BOOKS which was created by this transaction.

columns.name: UNPLANNED_TRX_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset unplanned depreciation transaction.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_TRX_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset retirement transaction.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset retirement.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Prorated cost of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: CIP_COST
columns.description: Prorated CIP cost of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: COST_CLEARING
columns.description: Prorated cost clearing amount of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: CIP_COST_CLEARING
columns.description: Prorated CIP cost clearing amount of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: EXPENSE
columns.description: Prorated depreciation amount of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: BONUS_EXPENSE
columns.description: Prorated bonus depreciation amount of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_EXPENSE
columns.description: Prorated impairment amount of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: RESERVE
columns.description: Prorated accumulated depreciation of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: BONUS_RESERVE
columns.description: Prorated accumulated bonus depreciation of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_RESERVE
columns.description: Prorated accumulated impairment amount of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Prorated accumulated revaluation amount of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: PROCEEDS_OF_SALE
columns.description: Prorated proceeds of sale amount the asset for this row.

columns.name: COST_OF_REMOVAL
columns.description: Prorated cost of removal amount of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: NBV_RETIRED
columns.description: Prorated net book value retired amount of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_COST
columns.description: Prorated original cost of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: RECOVERABLE_COST
columns.description: Prorated recoverable cost of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Prorated salvage value of the transaction for this row.

columns.name: DEPRN_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the depreciation amount for the transaction is overridden or not.

columns.name: MASS_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the mass transaction.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the impairment transaction.

columns.name: AH_TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the associated row in FA_ASSET_HISTORY for this extracted line.
